import re

    lines = f.readlines()

        # Extract Instance portion
        m = re.search(r"Instance:\s*(.*)$", line.strip())
        if m:
            items.append(m.group(1))
        else:
            items.append(line.strip())

print(f"total={len(items)}")
# Write chunk files for scouts
chunk_size = 210
for i in range(0, len(items), chunk_size):
    chunk = items[i:i+chunk_size]
    idx = i // chunk_size
    out = f"/tmp/yahoo_chunk_{idx:02d}.txt"
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        for j, text in enumerate(chunk):
            f.write(f"{i+j+1}\t{text}\n")
    print(f"wrote {out} n={len(chunk)} range={i+1}-{i+len(chunk)}")
